features.description: Install snapshot primitive. Add an operator-local `~/.dontpanic/install-snapshot.json` generated by `dontpanic init` after a successful walk/smoke and by a new `dontpanic reconcile baseline [--profile=<name>] [--yes]` command for existing installs. The snapshot is the reconciliation anchor and stores no secrets: schema_version, generated_at, dontpanic_version, profile, agent_manifest_schema_version, mcp_tool_names, capability ids, per-capability manifest fingerprint, per-capability setup_steps fingerprint, setup_step_ids, and status_cache metadata if present. Preview-by-default for baseline; writing requires `--yes`. File mode 0600.
steps: Add `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/install_snapshot.py` with typed model, snapshot builder, read/write helpers, deterministic capability/setup-step fingerprints, and 0600 write mode.
Include current MCP tool names by reusing the MCP registry/list surface without starting the stdio server.
Wire `dontpanic init` to write the snapshot after successful walk/smoke. Preserve existing init exit semantics; snapshot write failure should surface as install failure, not silently disappear.
Add `dontpanic reconcile baseline [--profile=<profile>] [--yes] [--format=text|json]`. Without `--yes`, preview the snapshot path and content summary but do not write.
Handle existing installs with no snapshot: `reconcile baseline --yes` creates the anchor; no migration from `.jarvis` writes secrets.
Add tests for model shape, no-secret fields, deterministic fingerprints, mode 0600, init hook, baseline preview, baseline write, JSON output, and missing capability dir failure.
features.acceptance: (1) `~/.dontpanic/install-snapshot.json` schema exists in code and includes no secret-shaped field names. (2) Snapshot captures dontpanic_version, profile, MCP tool names, capability ids, manifest fingerprints, setup-step fingerprints, and setup_step_ids. (3) `dontpanic init` writes snapshot after a successful install walk/smoke. (4) `dontpanic reconcile baseline` is preview-only by default; `--yes` writes with file mode 0600. (5) Re-running baseline with unchanged inputs is deterministic except generated_at. (6) JSON and text output are both available. (7) Tests cover at least the cases listed in steps. (8) Sanitization clean.

evidence_refs.note: Install snapshot model, builder, deterministic fingerprints, and 0600 writer.
F001 baseline CLI surface; F002 check remains pending.
dontpanic init writes the install snapshot after successful walk/smoke.
F001 focused regression tests; local run passed 15 tests.

features.description: Capability drift reconciliation. Add `dontpanic reconcile check [--area=capabilities] [--format=text|json]` that compares current capability manifests and setup_steps against `~/.dontpanic/install-snapshot.json`. It detects missing snapshot, new capabilities, removed capabilities, changed manifest fingerprints, changed setup_steps fingerprints, changed setup_step_ids, and stale/missing `~/.dontpanic/capabilities-status.json`. It must not mutate state. It gives exact next commands: `dontpanic reconcile baseline --yes` for a missing/stale baseline and `dontpanic capabilities status` for stale/missing status cache.
steps: Add `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/reconcile.py` with pure comparison functions and renderer.
Route `dontpanic reconcile check` and `dontpanic reconcile baseline` from the top-level CLI.
Implement capability drift result statuses: clean, missing_snapshot, new_capabilities, removed_capabilities, changed_capabilities, stale_status_cache.
Use the install snapshot as the only baseline; do not infer from doctor output.
Read current capabilities through the existing `capabilities.py` loader and status-cache metadata from `~/.dontpanic/capabilities-status.json` when present.
Text output should be compact and actionable; JSON output should be stable for agents.
Add tests for clean state, missing snapshot, new capability, removed capability, setup-step change, manifest-only change, missing cache, stale cache, JSON shape, and no-mutation behavior.
features.acceptance: (1) `dontpanic reconcile check --area=capabilities` exits 0 when current capabilities match the snapshot and cache is fresh. (2) Missing snapshot exits non-zero with exact baseline command. (3) New/removed/changed capabilities are reported by capability_id with old/current fingerprints where applicable. (4) Changed setup_step_ids are named. (5) Missing/stale capabilities-status cache is reported with exact `dontpanic capabilities status` command. (6) `--format=json` emits a stable envelope agents can parse. (7) Command never mutates files. (8) Tests cover at least the cases listed in steps. (9) Sanitization clean.
